name: CLASSIC 60 LPH RO SYSTEM
summary: The Classic 60 LPH RO System is a high-performance commercial water purifier designed to deliver a continuous supply of safe and purified water for offices, restaurants, schools, hospitals, and small commercial establishments.
intro: The Classic 60 LPH RO System is a high-performance commercial water purifier designed to deliver a continuous supply of safe and purified water for offices, restaurants, schools, hospitals, and small commercial establishments. Equipped with dual 150 GPD pumps, four 80 GPD RO membranes, and a multi-stage filtration system, it effectively removes dissolved impurities, excess TDS, bacteria, and harmful contaminants. With a purification capacity of 60 litres per hour, water level controller, and durable wall-mount or tabletop design, it ensures reliable performance for high-demand applications.
extra: B.N.Q.S - 150 GPD - 2 NOS, ECHEN 150 GPD - 2 NOS
